Mapbox GL JS 3.9.4 (https://docs.mapbox.com/mapbox-gl-js/), dist/ of the npm package mapbox-gl: global window.mapboxgl.
Proprietary, see LICENSE.txt: it needs a Mapbox account and access token, and the logo and attribution must stay visible.
Vendored so the page loads no CDN script. Loaded by lockerMap.jsp only when config/mapbox.local.properties has a token.
